preconditions: The canonical fixed-address executable identity must pass the SDK PE-header gate.
The whole-instruction entry window at 0x0042C690 must equal 55 8B EC 83 E4 F8 before detour installation.
The hook is an internal observation/dispatch boundary; mods must not invoke the original function independently.
postconditions: The original function returns through its trampoline and its opaque EAX result is preserved.
In the observed phase-5 race, persistent tick progress remains monotonic and the modulo-400 counter matches the per-call tick advance.
In the bounded dispatch proof, all 256 worker-posted no-op tasks executed exactly once on the hook thread with no missing, duplicate, or wrong-thread execution.
In the broker coexistence proof, two registered clients executed 512/512 tasks with no missing, duplicate, or wrong-thread execution; stale tokens and a competing detour were rejected.

In the broker stress proof, a hostile producer completed 14,040 tasks while a polite producer completed 40/40 with 9.772 ms maximum latency; one 10.148 ms callback was quarantined and its seven remaining tasks were purged.
In the same-process restart proof, RestartGate returned 4 once, the broker observed one exit and re-entry, session generation advanced from 1 to 2, and the old generation was rejected.
side_effects: The original function advances a variable-sized simulation batch and crosses multiple game-owned subsystem boundaries.
The passive probe adds only bounded memory sampling around the original call; it performs no semantic game-state mutation.

lifecycle.owner: broker session generation derived from RestartGate return episodes

unresolved: The semantic meaning of the return value is unresolved.
The concrete C++ type and ownership of receiver 0x005EC6D0 remain opaque.

Startup phase 0, active phase 5, one mini-restart exit, and a second same-process active session are observed; garage, full return-to-menu exit, replay, multiplayer, and natural process teardown remain unobserved.
The function is not once per frame: it averaged 265.45 calls per second while advancing the simulation at 400.027 ticks per session-second.
Cooperative coexistence and hostile-producer isolation are observed through one broker, but native callback fault containment and packaged process-wide discovery remain unresolved.
tests_required: Lifecycle observation across garage and a full return-to-menu session exit.
Clean detach while the game remains live, repeated across multiple runs.
Semantic command test: independently reviewed command executes only in its valid phase and owner lifetime.
Variant resolution and expected-byte validation for every supported executable.
